CFML Language Reference: Functions

ArrayPrepend

Inserts a value at position 1. All existing elements move up one position.

Category

Array functions

Syntax

ArrayPrepend(array, value)

Parameters

array
The array to change.
value
The value to add as the new first element.

Returns

TRUE (prints as YES).

Usage

ArrayPrepend(a, v) is the same as ArrayInsertAt(a, 1, v). To add at the end, use ArrayAppend.

Example

Opens the example in a new window. The example runs on this server, so it only works when you browse from the server itself (127.0.0.1).
<CFSET Countdown = ListToArray("2,1,Happy New Year!")>
<CFSET Temp = ArrayPrepend(Countdown, "3")>
<CFSET Temp = ArrayPrepend(Countdown, "4")>
<CFOUTPUT>
<P>#ArrayToList(Countdown, " ... ")#</P>
<P>First element: <B>#Countdown[1]#</B></P>
</CFOUTPUT>

See also

ArrayAppend, ArrayInsertAt, ListPrepend
